title: LM Router 1.0.0
release_notes:
### 🖥 On-device Gateway
• Your own Kiri Router gateway, fetched live and running on this device. No setup, no API key
• Live model catalog with per-model rate limits and endpoint types
• Closing the window keeps the gateway running; Quit is always in the header

### 💬 Chat
• Streaming replies with visible reasoning and expandable tool calls
• The `auto` model rotates across healthy free models and prefers ones with tool support
• Copy, regenerate, or edit-and-resend any message

### 🔧 Tools & Sharing
• Built-in web search with keyless fallbacks, plus your own MCP servers
• Share the gateway on a public URL with an optional API key

### 🗂 History & Settings
• On-device conversation history with markdown export
• Theme, generation parameters, providers, and in-app update checks
